title: Grateful Dead Live at Fillmore West on 1969-06-06

ai_review.summary: Soundboard capture of the legendary June 6 1969 gig with an epic 47‑minute Turn On Your Lovelight, crisp audio and Elvin Bishop’s fiery Smokestack Lightnin.
ai_review.review: This recording preserves a historic one‑disc show dominated by a monster 47‑minute Turn On Your Lovelight that showcases the band at peak psychedelic energy. The soundboard source is generally clear and listenable, with only occasional mentions of splices or unevenness, while guest guitarist Elvin Bishop adds a blues‑rock edge on Smokestack Lightnin and Beat It On Down The Line.

ai_rating.rationale: The majority of reviews (20+) are 4–5 stars, praising the unique performance and good sound quality; weighted rating yields a strong 4.3.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Generally clear and listenable with crisp mix; a few reviewers note possible splice around 33:25 and occasional unevenness, but no major drop‑outs.

standout_songs: Beat It On Down The Line (guest guitar)
show_quality.setlist_flow: One‑disc set focused on an extended Lovelight jam, punctuated by blues‑driven guest spots that keep the momentum high despite the absence of a Dark Star.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Late to the early part of the show and possibly absent on some tracks, but returns for Lovelight where his guitar tone ‘saved’ the performance.
band_member_comments.Phil: Described as zonked from the spiked apple juice; bass lines are less driven than usual, with Phil noting the chaotic vibe in his book.
